locations.note: Ryo Hazuki arrives in Hong Kong in 1987 pursuing his father's killer, Lan Di.
Ryo's journey ends among the karst hills of Guilin, in the village of Bailu.
Ryo lands in Wan Chai in 1987 and starts his search among its markets and martial-arts halls.
Zhu Yuanda hides from the Chi You Men inside the Walled City, where Ryo and Ren go looking for him.
